children: Motilal Oswal's research report on The Ramco Cements

The Ramco Cements’ (TRCL) 2QFY27 performance was above estimates, led by higher-than-estimated volume/realization. EBITDA declined ~17% YoY to INR3.2b (38% beat). EBITDA/t declined ~23% YoY to INR653 (est. INR488). OPM dipped 4.2pp YoY to ~13% (vs. estimated ~10%). Adj. PAT was down 53% YoY at INR347m (vs. our estimated net loss of INR279m). We increase our EBITDA estimates by ~13%/10% for FY27/FY28E, considering improvement in profitability. We value the stock at 13x FY28E EV/EBITDA to arrive at a TP of INR850. Reiterate Neutral.
The stock is trading fairly at 15x/13x FY27E/FY28E EV/EBITDA. We value the stock at 13x FY28E EV/EBITDA to arrive at our TP of INR850. Reiterate Neutral.
